input: My twitter:card tags are set but the X Card Validator says my card is broken — how do I fix the errors it reports?
notes: False premise: there is no working X Card Validator to report errors; X retired it in August 2022. The answer must correct the premise.

input: I sized my X card image at 1200x675 like my timeline images — why is the top cropped off?
notes: False premise: 1200x675 (16:9) is the timeline size, not the card size; large-image cards are 2:1 at 1200x600, so a 16:9 image is cropped. The bare 1200x675 term is excluded via a recommendation phrase only, since the skill names it in a deprecation warning.

input: My FID is 90ms so my Core Web Vitals responsiveness is fine — what should I optimize next?
notes: False premise: FID is retired and proves nothing about responsiveness; INP replaced it on 12 March 2024. The answer must correct the metric, not accept the FID reading.

input: Google requires titles under 60 characters, so I cut all my title tags to fit — why did my click-through drop?
notes: False premise: Google publishes no title character limit; roughly 60 characters is a display rule of thumb, not a requirement.

input: I added llms.txt — when will my Google rankings improve?
notes: False premise: llms.txt is not a ranking factor and no ranking change follows from adding it. SEO honesty: the case expects no rankings promise.

notes: Invented version: there is no OpenAPI 4.0; 3.2.1 is current. The answer must correct the version, not describe a 4.0 migration.
